nodes.label: OLMo-Hybrid-7B
nodes.rationale: Hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Net (GDN) recurrent layers with attention in a 3:1 ratio (block pattern gdn,gdn,gdn,attn); d_model 3840, 32 layers, 65,536 context. Based on OLMo3 7B but with attention heads reduced to 30 (from 32) to match params/TPS for a fair comparison with the pure transformer variant.

nodes.label: OLMo-Hybrid Staged Training Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Staged approach: stage 1 pretraining on dolma3 (OLMo-mix-0925), stage 2 midtraining on dolma3-dolmino, stage 3 long-context on dolma3-longmino. Multiple midtraining runs (ingredients 1 and 2) are souped. The long-context stage extends to 65k sequence length by dropping RoPE (DroPE) and using context parallelism with Ulysses (degree=2).

nodes.label: OLMo-Hybrid Think/Instruct SFT & DPO
nodes.rationale: Think is fine-tuned from the long-context checkpoint on think SFT data (2 epochs, lr 2.5e-5, 32k seq) using a mixture of Dolci-Think-SFT-32B (1x) plus five tool-use SFT datasets (3x upsampled each). Instruct is fine-tuned from the Think SFT checkpoint. Both use FSDP, Ulysses context parallelism (degree=2), activation checkpointing, and a 3% linear warmup; Instruct additionally has a DPO stage in open-instruct.
